description: Open Dataset of Photovoltaic Plant Operational Measurements (Spain) – February 2026 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Cuerva Energía. This dataset contains operational measurements collected from the photovoltaic power plant in Spain within the framework of the COCOON project. The dataset covers the period from 11 February 2026 to 15 February 2026 and includes time-series measurements from the two grid-connected inverters and the Point of Interconnection (POI). Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
